$comment: Single source of truth for vendored/adopted skill pools consumed by BOTH harness bridges: opencode/plugins/dotfiles-bridge.ts (OpenCode; skills+commands+agents) and omp/extensions/dotfiles-skills.ts (OMP; resources_discover skillPaths). Marketplace-installed pools do NOT belong here - Claude's installed_plugins.json is their source of truth and both harnesses ingest it natively. Fields: root = package root relative to the dotfiles dir (skills expected at <root>/skills); namespace = bridge namespace; skills=false = bridge skips skills (OpenCode loads them natively from ~/.claude/skills); commands=false = OpenCode bridge skips <root>/commands (a pool whose commands we do not want exposed); OMP ignores this field entirely - it takes commands only from plugins/sjawhar/commands via a single ~/.omp/agent/prompts symlink, see omp/AGENTS.md; omp=false = OMP skips this pool (it gets it via its own plugin install); ompSkillsDir = OMP scans this dir instead of <root>/skills (supports ~/ prefix; for pools living outside the dotfiles tree, e.g. ~/core-ops). OMP never reads a harness-curated dir (~/.claude, ~/.config/opencode): unwanted skills from a vendor pool are excluded via omp/config.yml skills.ignoredSkills.

sources.$comment: One agent-c skill, linked per-skill by installers/opencode.sh into a farm; pointing at agent-c's whole skills directory would publish ~100 skills. Claude Code and OpenCode get the same skill via ~/.claude/skills; OMP does not read that path.
